description: MasterAudit explains retrospective evidence-coherence review, supported task types, the published compliance profile and technical-evidence policy. Its public tools retrieve guidance only. It explains how to interpret an audit event, ledger and integrity certificate, including the need for human review. These tools do not retrieve private evidence, execute audits, create certificates or send reports. Coherence and integrity do not establish truth, guilt, liability or legal validity. The module remains experimental.

defaultPrompt: Explain whether MasterAudit fits my retrospective evidence review.
Show MasterAudit's supported evidence-review task types.
Explain what an integrity certificate can and cannot establish.
